decision_question: Should Kizz route any bounded class of Codex debugging work through the exact source-locked systematic-debugging snapshot, keep it optional, or reject that exact snapshot on the frozen stack?

execution_authority.risk_scope: The owner explicitly authorized local Codex authentication for public-skill testing. This admission narrows that authority to the exact reviewed snapshot, four sanitized maintainer-controlled fixtures, eight scored calls, and the declared proxy host allowlist.

evidence_boundary.task_material: Synthetic sanitized fixtures and private root-cause dossiers; no customer, production, credential, or proprietary repository data.
evidence_boundary.provider_transfer: Fixture and task prompt bytes may be sent to the hosted OpenAI Codex service under the owner's account authorization.
evidence_boundary.public_projection: Only allowlisted Contract v0 scalars, bounded prose, source identity, and opaque hashes; never raw task, dossier, evaluator, event, candidate, score, authentication, canary, or private path bytes.
evidence_boundary.chronology_claim: Git proves artifact ordering and the runner records per-cell UTC metadata; neither independently timestamps every private model call.
evidence_boundary.claim_ceiling: Screening-derived bounded internal routing signal for the exact candidate, stack, tasks, and qualifying stratum; no global effectiveness, leaderboard, transfer, or production-outcome claim.

rules.scope: Opt-in routing only for exact qualifying strata on the frozen Kizz Codex stack; baseline fallback remains available.
Block only revision 44c9b2d6e889982ac18c27d05a19fefe335194e1 / tree 46da4917... on the frozen Codex stack.
Retain the exact snapshot as an explicit research option; do not route to it by default and do not install it globally.

role_overlaps: Kizz authored and sanitized the private tasks, operates the hosted-model runner, owns the deterministic evaluator and evidence interpretation, and precommits the downstream action policy.
The candidate artifact is externally authored, but no independent task selection, execution, evaluation, or replication exists.
stop_rules: Stop before a call if admission, manifest, source lock, candidate, pack, code, prompt, or image identity differs from the freeze.
Stop after credential persistence, fixture mutation, invalid output, evaluator failure, missing treatment activation, budget breach, or non-empty scored cell path.
Do not retry model outcomes or modify tasks, evaluators, rules, prompts, runtime, or action mapping after observing scored output.
Any private canary or private task/evaluator content in a public projection blocks publication and invalidates the publication package.

follow_up_plan.window: Next ten naturally eligible internal debugging cases or 30 days after the recorded action, whichever comes first.
signals: critical failure or unsafe scope expansion
follow_up_plan.reversal_trigger: One critical failure, material regression, private-data incident, candidate/source drift, or evidence that selective routing increases rework disables the policy pending a new admission.
